attachment_sets.label: Head study interchangeable heads
attachment_sets.notes: Runtime attachment surface for the reviewed shared 2x3 body. Each variant is an exact reviewed 2x2 upper-body source canvas that overlays the shared lower body row.

documented_hints: The Characters sheet stays on the same authoritative 8x8 source grid as Minimal 8, but it is dominated by multi-cell figures, busts, and small accessory fragments rather than one-cell environment tiles.
Large actors from this sheet should normally reach runtime through reviewed constructions or another explicit multi-cell composition surface, not by pretending the whole figure is a single tile.
The approved source-layout ingestion map captures the sheet's coarse reviewed structure only: head study, medieval sets, sci-fi sets, monsters, and the excluded palette/byline strip.
The first promoted runtime surface is the top-row head study: one shared 2x3 body target, one unique full figure, and 2x2 interchangeable head attachments derived from the reviewed source canvases.
The broader sheet is still intentionally conservative. Outside the head study, it does not yet settle fine-grained swap metadata or the runtime representation of the large figures.
